entities.summary: Edward Lee Thrasher Jr. was an American art director and photographer. He was the recipient of a number of Grammy Award nominations for his work on album covers and won a Grammy for Best Album Package in 1974 for the Mason Proffit cover Come & Gone. He worked with various recording artists and is known for his influence on album cover design.
